Plan for the overnight alignment, playbook cluster-run.

1. Check the arc aliases and move to a compute node.
2. Confirm the reference index exists on the shared data root.
3. Write align.sbatch as a 48-task array, eight cores and 32G each, logs under logs/.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=align
#SBATCH --array=1-48%12
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
python align.py --sample "$sample" --out "results/$sample"
```

4. Submit the array with sbatch align.sbatch and watch it with squeue -u $USER through the
   night, resubmitting any task that fails.
5. In the morning, verify the outputs, commit the results summary, open the PR and merge it.

Results will be in results/ when you wake up.
